title: Kinematics
description: The kinematic data of the robot models, in one place: for each model the range of every joint and its home pose (degrees) and, where it is known, the chain of the arm as a URDF states it (the offset from the parent in meters, the rotation in radians, the axis of each joint) together with the numbers it was built from. The apps and the server read this one document instead of keeping a copy each. The schema is closed.

additionalProperties.description: Lowest and highest angle of the joint, in degrees.
The angle of the joint in the home pose, in degrees.

convention.description: How the joints are written. The offset and the rotation of each joint are those of a URDF joint origin.

pos.description: Offset from the parent joint, in meters.

rpy.description: Rotation from the parent joint, in radians (roll, pitch, yaw).

parameters.description: The numbers the chain was built from (for example the Denavit-Hartenberg values of the maker), by name.
